in_sanskrit.name: प्राणजलि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives life, or the one who offers prayers with devotion.

in_marathi.name: Praanjali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Praanjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Praan' meaning 'life' and 'Jali' meaning 'wave', Praanjali signifies a 'gift of love' or a 'wave of life'. It is believed to bring harmony, joy, and nurturing energy.
